{{Quote|I was not ''expecting'' you to bring company.''"<br />"''My ''apologies, Count Dooku''. This is Nemb from the Adoy Clan. He also has Republic scrap I believe you would be ''most'' interested in.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and a [[Jawa]]|<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />}}
The '''Adoy Clan''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] clan. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] posed as "Nemb," a Jawa [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] of the Adoy Clan, while on a [[Mission to Tatooine (Yoda)|mission]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
